items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: my grandfather was a man that stood on his own convictions, meant every word he said.

ctx.x: And his father didn't look for him after he told him to get out. He didn't for his father after he told him to get out. That's how firm the situation was. But he was -- my grandfather was a man that stood on his own convictions, meant every word he said. And that's the way it was.
Well, now, when do you start sort of -- you did say the school was very near where you lived with your grandfather, didn't you?
